notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE: Crafting & Online Item Marketplace
notes.notes:
You can now Craft special (one use) items with materials you can find in the levels (you find one per 2 level finishes) There is a total of 12 different items, currently there are 2 recipe's you can craft, if your interested in them, you can see them ingame (Main menu > Inventory button top right, click Craft & Inventory, and there you can see the recipe buttons on top, click the learn more button top left for more information)
More crafting recipe's are coming soon.
Players can sell items, the server will automatically pay and tax the player when selling an item, then the server will list the item and sell it to another player in the Marketplace, make sure you check the marketplace often, because prices might swing : )

notes.title: Join the Fun! Stewart the Fox Multiplayer is Here! 🦊🎮
notes.notes:
[h3]Stewart felt extra social today, and he's calling all his friends to the new multiplayer platforming and speedrunning party in Stewart The Fox! 🌟 Team up with friends to conquer 6 exciting levels![/h3]

[h2]👬 Assemble Your Crew![/h2]
Gather up to 6 players in the multiplayer lobbies and dive into the action. Whether you're exploring maps together or competing for the fastest time, the more, the merrier!

[h2]🌐 How to Create or Join a Multiplayer Lobby:[/h2]
Open Stewart The Fox, in the Main menu, click the Multiplayer button. If there are active lobbies, they will load in the server browser. If there is no lobby, you can click the Create a server button at the right top of the server browser.

[h2]🎮 Let the Multiplayer Fun Begin![/h2]
Stewart and his friends are waiting for you. Jump into Stewart The Fox multiplayer now and have fun with your friends. Happy gaming!

[h2]📑Extra Multiplayer Information[/h2]
Bonus Map 2 (Egypt) is not available in the Multiplayer mode.
Some maps have been altered to support multiplayer mode (e.g., removal of moving snowballs/logs in level 4, the area got flooded and a new log-parkour part has came into existance!). This removal is only for the Multiplayer Mode.
In the Halloween bonus map (3), the haunting house has been replaced by an extra parkour (Multiplayer Only). 👻

🦊🎮 

Check the trailer on youtube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HrfiQZemKvY

notes.title: Stewart The Fox QOL Update, Happy New Year! 🎉
notes.notes:
[h1]Exciting news! The Quality of Life (QOL) Update for Stewart The Fox is here. Here’s what’s new:[/h1]

[list]
[*] [b]Improved Visual Feedback[/b]: A small shadow circle now appears beneath Stewart while in the air. This helps players better visualize where they are and where they’ll land.

[*] [b]Optimized Jumping Mechanics[/b]: Adjustments have been made to the jump height and general gravity settings of Stewart. Some issues were noticed with these mechanics after the release of the 2nd Bonus map, resulting in a game experience that felt unresponsive and floaty. These issues have now been rectified.

[*] [b]One-Hit Enemies[/b]: All regular enemies can now be defeated with just one hit! Just the way it should be. 😉

[*] [b]Yeti Boss Update[/b]: The Yeti boss has been made easier to hit, enhancing the overall gameplay experience.

[*] [b]Death cams[/b]: Death cams have been added to the 2 bonus maps where they didnt function before (bonus map 1 & 2)
[/list]


NOTE: Stay tuned for more information on a new game that’s currently in development!

Stewart, DeadEagle, and Spitfire-Games, Wish you a Happy New Year!
